title: Ship the macOS Meadow redesign and month and landmark focus mode, though the Claude Design summary omitted both
context: Diffing Meadow Scene.dc.html against the session's first archive copy showed a full macOS redesign (full-bleed scene, bottom glass dock, right-hand details panel, keys D, F, arrows, Esc) and a focus mode on both platforms that the pasted summary never mentions.
options: ship the macOS redesign with the phone
outcome: Both ship. The macOS Meadow goes full-bleed with the dock, panel and keys; desktop full screen uses the same layout. Focus mode: tapping a month or a landmark in the details pans to those days, dims the rest and swaps the dock for a stepper whose close reopens the details.
